acceptanceCriteria: Recovery retry is identity-bound and restores only a legal lifecycle state after a failed finish; no generated status or Outcome bytes are hand-edited.
Superseded archive manifests bind contract, summary, outcome, task report, and markdown digests, and the predecessor can reach an explicit historical close.
Regression tests cover failed finish retry, supersession, archive binding, malformed or stale recovery receipts, and predecessor immutability.
Tri-language workflow and Outcome documentation describe the recovery boundary and successor rule.
All existing workspace tests and governance gates remain passing.
goal: A failed finish or equivalent governance gate can be explicitly retried or superseded, archive manifests remain internally bound, and the recovery path cannot strand a valid Work Item or weaken predecessor immutability.
intent: Repair fail-closed Work Item recovery after a lifecycle gate failure without hand-editing generated records.
